# Six illustrated chapter dividers

Generated on 28 October 2026 with OpenAI image generation for this personal birthday scrapbook. The owner explicitly requested image-based left-hand chapter dividers. This is original decorative collage artwork, not a photograph of the couple, their actual pets or a documented journey.

The image uses cream and blush paper, pink ribbon, cherry hearts, sage paper, autumn pressing and pasted cutout textures. Its six quiet lower areas hold real, accessible chapter headings supplied by the page renderer. There is no generated wording. Silver number balloons read 25, the owner's confirmed birthday age.

The original result's tile ratio is about 0.753, slightly wider than the scrapbook's 5:7 paper. A runtime uniformly scaled crop or contain fit can accommodate this. No person, celebrity likeness, personal pet photograph, travel fact, gift code or new brand artwork is generated.

V93 fills the Photographs tile's two apertures at runtime using the owner's original configured photographs. The rear mount uses the selected main photograph; the front prefers a distinct RE11 journey photograph, falling back to another configured photo. Matching clipped HTML images and canvas printing preserve the original frame overlap and ornaments. These small decorative previews use centered cover crops; the photo readers retain the full originals. The original generated atlas bytes remain unchanged.

V94 supersedes V93: no divider uses personal photographs. The Moments to keep. chapter now uses the separate `moments-divider.webp` ornament-only illustration, with no photo frames. The old atlas remains intact for other chapters and historical provenance; its Polaroid tile is no longer displayed. Runtime photo selection/compositing is removed from both rendering paths.
